description: Single source of truth for the rule-identifier and semantic step-identifier vocabulary shared by the analysis engine (auto-refactor) and the workspace gate scripts. Both surfaces compile the shapes below instead of restating them, because the two copies had drifted: the gate treated any '<PREFIX>-[A-Z0-9]-<2-digit>' token as a semantic step identifier while the engine only recognized 'PC-nn-nn' and 'PP-nn-nn', so every gate step identifier looked like a hallucinated rule id to the engine. Nothing about a rule identifier is decided here; only its SHAPE and the vocabulary of benign non-rule tokens.

notes.boundary: The candidate shape refuses to begin immediately after a hyphen or underscore, so 'DEV-ARCH-001' inside 'KALAR-DEV-ARCH-001' is read as the tail of one identifier rather than as a separate rule id.
notes.semanticStepIdTail: Semantic step identifiers carry a two-digit position suffix; rule identifiers carry a three-digit number. The two tails cannot collide, so a two-digit tail is treated as a step identifier and never as a rule id.
notes.degradedMode: When this file is unreachable, the engine reports no drift rather than reporting everything: the same documented degradation the rule catalog uses, so a standalone consumer without the workspace tree is not flooded.
